import math

unit depth: length = -x

schema D scope logical:
    id: String key
    d: depth mutable

rule rounded:
    D r where round(r.d) == 2_depth
->
    log info "round"

rule floored:
    D r where math.floor(r.d) == 2_depth
->
    log info "floor"
